chapter.heading: Joy in the Salvation of the LordTo the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
The king
shall have joy in Your strength, O Lord;And in Your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice! [Ps. 1:1; 37:1; Prov. 23:17]

You have
given him his heart’s desire,And have not withheld the request of his lips.Selah

For You
meet him with the blessings of goodness;You set a crown of pure gold upon his head.

He asked
life from You, and You gave it to him—Length of days forever and ever.

His glory
is great in Your salvation;Honor and majesty You have placed upon him. [Prov. 21:22; Eccl. 9:16]

For You
have made him most blessed forever;You have made him exceedingly glad with Your presence. [Luke 14:31]

For the
king trusts in the Lord,And through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved. [Ps. 10:5; Prov.]

Your hand
will find all Your enemies;Your right hand will find those who hate You. [Prov. 6:14; 14:22; Rom. 1:30]

You shall
make them as a fiery oven in the time of Your anger;The Lord shall swallow them up in His wrath,And the fire shall devour them.

Their offspring
You shall destroy from the earth,And their descendants from among the sons of men. [Deut. 20:8; Job 4:5; Jer. 51:46; Heb. 12:3]

For they
intended evil against You;They devised a plot which they are not able to perform. [Ps. 82:4; Is. 58:6, 7; 1 John 3:16]

Therefore You
will make them turn their back;You will make ready Your arrows on Your string toward their faces. [1 Sam. 16:7; Prov. 21:2 i Job 34:11; Ps. 62:12; Rev. 2:23; 22:12]

Be exalted,
O Lord, in Your own strength!We will sing and praise Your power. [Ps. 19:10; 119:103; Prov. 25:16; Song 5:1]
